fingerprint_method: Sorted morice/**/*.py or tests/**/*.py: Windows relative path bytes followed by file bytes, SHA-256.

local_suite_diagnostic.scope: An earlier failed full run emitted a 120-second watchdog diagnostic during themed-dialog event draining and later continued. The final complete run emitted no such diagnostic; the earlier shared-process slowdown remains retained in local logs. Separate actual native-window checks passed.

live_geography.provider: Photon / OpenStreetMap with GeoNames offline fallback
live_geography.gujrat_explicit_choice: Indian Gujarat state and Pakistani Gujrat settlements displayed; actual Use selected place button selected the Indian state.
live_geography.measurement_scope: Provider-supplied representative points; not road routes or nearest borders.
live_geography.latency_check: Actual standalone provider responses took about 3.62 seconds for gujrat and 7.81 seconds for Gujarat. The earlier three/six-second cutoffs were too low; the final ten-second socket timeout and 22-second capability deadline permit these healthy slower lookups.

media.readiness: Ready: prompt only. Model files are checked before generation.
media.scope: Actual UI with existing local model metadata; no new real-weight inference.
media.controlled_generation: Actual existing media scheduler/subprocess writes and verifies an image with no reference or mask. Stale edit paths are not read in text-to-image. A discovered fixture model is inspected on demand. Native UI uses the already-installed SD-Turbo metadata without loading weights.

regression_focus: Exact screenshot questions parse without how far in the location name
Online city/state/country lookup and one-day persisted cache
Ambiguous Gujrat/Gujarat and same-name city/state explicit selection
Healthy slower-provider budget retains online choices instead of forcing offline city coordinates
Generic locate requests keep the existing chat/file route
Network denial never contacts provider and uses offline cities
Unknown place preserves previous context and reports the current query
Slow provider leaves GUI snapshot lock responsive
Concurrent Spatial commands and geocoder admission fail immediately; invalid coordinates are rejected
Prompt-only image creates a verified artifact through the existing process scheduler
Discovered model inspection, compatible initial model selection, repeat-click prevention and recovery
Existing native compact Media geometry and unavailable-workflow message

native_capture.scope: Actual owned Qt windows and controls, isolated profiles; not physical mouse, microphone, camera or device certification.

wheel.dependency_scope: Two existing dependency environments, not a fresh dependency installation.

retained_development_failures: An early new test asserted the wrong Future result shape; it was corrected to assert ExecutionResult.success. Native compatibility testing caught an unavailable-video-workflow wording regression, corrected before the final app source. The first full run was stopped after a slow global Qt style change. Five new Media UI cases now retain every assertion in separate owned subprocesses. A later full run emitted a Qt watchdog diagnostic and completed with one failed factory test: it expected New York to be uniquely resolved by default. That factory/authority test now explicitly selects installed offline coordinates and restores the shared lookup setting; online ambiguity remains independently covered. A separate partial run was stopped to include the city/state fix. The final diagnostic field records the current completed run; no stopped or failed run is counted as a pass.
constraints: Photon demo coverage and uptime are not guaranteed; named-place search does not download every address/POI/boundary. A configurable compatible HTTPS endpoint is available.
State/country distances use representative coordinates. Road routing and nearest-border distances remain unavailable.

At most one outgoing request per second, bounded response, ten-second socket inactivity timeout and a 22-second capability deadline; in-flight HTTP cancellation is cooperative. One short pacing wait can occupy a worker for at most about one second; simultaneous lookup admission does not queue.

New real SD-Turbo inference remains constrained by available RAM: about 2.8 GiB during initial checks and 4.27 GiB at the final resource check, versus roughly 5.7 GiB required. The user accepted documenting this limit. No new weights were downloaded.
Existing project proposal/model output budgets, supported computational model assumptions and physical device/compositor limitations remain as documented in earlier version reports.
authorities: Extends CapabilityKernel, TaskGraph, WorkerManager, AgentCoordinator, SharedTaskState, existing resource leases, verification contracts, permission handling and process ownership. Deterministic math/local operations retain existing bypass paths.
publication: Public Package-Contents binds archived and installed checks to the release commit. Exact-commit CI, Release validation and Pages plus live website QA gate publication.
